content:
The image shows a mango leaf with distinct dark brown/black irregular lesions scattered across the upper surface. The lesions are:
- Irregular in shape, roughly circular to angular
- Dark brown to black in color with defined margins
- Located on the leaf blade (not powdery, not sooty coating)
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No black sooty surface coating (rules out Sooty Mould)
- No tip/branch dieback pattern (rules out Die_Back)
- Lesions are characteristic of Anthracnose — necrotic spots caused by *Colletotrichum* spp., which produces dark, sunken lesions on mango leaves
